competences.description: Attacks the enemy with a sharp blade and inflicts continuous damage for 2 turns with a 50% chance.

effets.description: The target's HP will be damaged by 5% of the MAX HP whenever the target's turn returns. (Ignores Defense)

competences.description: Attacks all enemies 2 times with a sharp wind and weakens the Defense for 2 turns with a 50% chance for each attack. Your Attack Bar will increase by 15% each when the attack lands as a Critical Hit.

effets.description: The target's Defense will be decreased by 70%.
The ATK bar of ally monsters is filled by a set amount. This allows ally monsters to attack again sooner.

competences.description: Attacks an enemy target 5 times to steal 1 beneficial effect with each attack and Stuns the enemy for 1 turn with a 30% chance. The chance of the enemy being stunned increases as the enemy's HP decreases after the attack. The stun is guaranteed if the enemy has 50% or less HP.

effets.description: The target will be stunned and won't be able to attack.
effets.note: Stun chance increases as enemy HP decreases

effets.description: Remove a beneficial effect and take it for yourself
